youtube.description:
Uncle ne poocha: "Operation se pehle checkup kyun? Seedha kar do na!" 🩺
Dr Saathi ne kaha: nahi! Checkup se aapka anaesthesia plan surakshit banta hai. 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Aapki sehat, purani bimari aur allergy ke baare mein poochha jaata hai
✅ Apni saari dawaiyan (ya unki list) saath lekar aaiye
✅ Zaroorat ho toh khoon ki jaanch aur ECG hota hai
✅ Khaana-peena kab band karna hai aur kaunsi dawa leni hai, doctor ki team batayegi
Apni dawa khud band mat kijiye, doctor se poochhiye.
